# r10n

> CLI toolkit for automating repetitive data and workflow tasks: contacts, fill-pdfs, images, and email.

r10n is a Python CLI tool that automates everyday tasks with a beautiful interactive terminal UI. It supports two execution modes: instant execution via `uvx` (no installation required) and local installation for repeated use.

## Quick Start

Run any automation instantly without installation:
```bash
uvx --from git+https://github.com/pruthivithejan/r10n.git r10n --help
```

Or install locally:
```bash
git clone https://github.com/pruthivithejan/r10n.git
cd r10n
uv sync
uv run r10n --help
```

## Available Automations

### Contacts
Generate VCF contact cards from phone numbers.
```bash
uvx --from git+https://github.com/pruthivithejan/r10n.git r10n contacts --input numbers.txt --prefix Customer --output contacts.vcf
```

### Fill PDFs
Fill PDF templates with data from CSV/TXT files. Features a visual field picker and preview-approve loop.
```bash
uvx --from git+https://github.com/pruthivithejan/r10n.git r10n fill-pdfs --recipients data.csv
```

### Images
Optimize and convert images to WebP format.
```bash
uvx --from git+https://github.com/pruthivithejan/r10n.git r10n images --input ./photos --output ./optimized --quality 85
```

### Email
Send bulk personalized emails with attachments.
```bash
uvx --from git+https://github.com/pruthivithejan/r10n.git r10n email --config email-config.json --recipients recipients.csv --body body.txt
```

### Colors
Convert CSS color codes to oklch() format.
```bash
uvx --from git+https://github.com/pruthivithejan/r10n.git r10n colors --file styles.css
```

## Requirements

- Python 3.10+
- [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) package manager
